info.summary: Customer, partner (pro), member and staff API. Versioning and deprecation: docs/api/README.md.
info.description: All business routes live under /v1 (health and app-links at the root). Errors use the envelope {"error":{"code":"<stable_code>","message":"<optional>"}}. Lists are cursor-paginated where marked: pass the X-Next-Cursor response header back as `cursor`. Business dates are Korean dates (KST); timestamps are RFC 3339 in UTC.

post.summary: Start a payment checkout (idempotent). Optional `points` pays part with points: checked against balance and cap here, debited when the checkout settles; the response `amount` is what the PG charges (`total - points`). Booking checkouts may send `expected_total` (the total from POST /v1/bookings/price): another server price is a 409 `price_changed` before any PG window. Deposit checkouts are refused before any PG window when the selected pro is paused (409 `quality_paused`) or already booked at that time (409 `schedule_overlap`)

200.description: The intent the hosted pay page starts from (see CheckoutIntent). `gateway` names the hosted page: `portone` opens /pay/, `tosspayments` opens /pay/toss.html. post.summary: Confirm payment after the provider redirect (idempotent). An issued virtual account answers `status: awaiting_deposit` with `virtual_account` (see VirtualAccount), including the amount to deposit. A Toss Payments checkout whose success page has not captured yet answers 409 `payment_pending` (ask again; not a decline)

Capture a Toss Payments checkout from /pay/toss-success.html. Public: the page holds no session. `amount` must equal the checkout's charge (400 amount_mismatch before any Toss call); the server confirms with its own stored amount, never the client's. Repeats answer the settled state. Not Idempotency-Key replayable: the checkout state makes it idempotent. After it, the app calls POST /v1/checkouts/{id}/confirm as for PortOne

200.description: OK. Each integrations[] card carries last_test (the stored passing check, the Toss gate record), last_check (the latest check, passed or failed) and can_test (whether this viewer may run the connection test: the owner only on a locked card). Top level also has toss_payments_webhook_url ("{public_base_url}/v1/webhooks/tosspayments", for the Toss developer center) payment_gateways ([{code, mode}], PortOne first: every gateway a new payment can reach, [] when none is set up; mode is test | live for tosspayments, read from the secret key prefix, test meaning bookings are paid with no real money, and null for portone), and for older consoles payment_gateway (the first entry's code, portone when the list is empty) and payment_gateway_mode (its mode). The tosspayments card has fields client_key, secret_key, billing_client_key, billing_secret_key, security_key and active (toggle, on by default), and a mode (test | live | null) read from the secret key prefix

post.summary: What a fixed or unit booking would charge right now, by the same rules as createBooking and createCheckout (peak surcharge, coupon or first-booking offer). Read-only: nothing is held or charged. Quote services are refused (`quote_not_payable`).

CountUnit.description: One counts option of a service, in the owner's catalogue order. `label` is null for the built-in options (the app localises them by `label_key`).

PartnerJobCard.description: A job as a partner sees it. `unit_counts` and `count_units` are null for services without counts.

code.description: Stable machine code; clients branch on this, never on message text.

message.description: Optional human text. Never contains internals.

CountsPricing.description: Counts pricing (catalogue type "counts"). A booking sends `counts`: one integer per option, in catalogue order, each at most `max_each` (default 20). Two or more items take `multi_discount_bps` off, rounded to 100 won. Minutes total at least 60. Prices are placeholders until the owner sets them in the console.

BookingBody.description: Booking request. Counts services send `counts` (one integer per option, catalogue order); legacy single-unit services send `unit_index`.

counts.description: One count per catalogue option. Each at most max_each (default 20); at least one non-zero.

expected_total.description: The total the customer was shown (POST /v1/bookings/price). When sent and the server's price differs, 409 `price_changed` and nothing is charged.

Booking.description: A booking. `unit_counts` is set for counts services (and migrated mattress rows) and null otherwise; `unit_index` is kept for legacy clients.

PricePreview.description: Server price for a booking request. `total = list_price - multi_discount - discount`; points come off `total` at checkout.

list_price.description: Catalogue price plus peak_surcharge, before discounts

peak_surcharge.description: Weekend / holiday / evening surcharge for the slot (0 unless the owner applies peak to fixed visits)

discount.description: Coupon discount, or the first-booking offer when welcome is true

total.description: Charged before points; send back as expected_total

VirtualAccount.description: Virtual-account deposit details. `amount` is the exact sum to deposit (the checkout's charge: total after discounts, less points).

CheckoutIntent.description: Parameters for the hosted payment page. New checkouts use the gateway that serves the chosen method: PortOne when it has the method's channel key, else Toss Payments (see GET /v1/payments/methods `gateway`).

id.description: Checkout id; also the gateway's paymentId (PortOne) or orderId (Toss Payments)

amount.description: What the gateway charges: total - points

store_id.description: PortOne store id; null for Toss Payments

channel_key.description: The key the hosted page starts its SDK with: the PortOne channel key, or the Toss Payments client key (test_ck_/live_ck_ of the payment-window MID)

cash_receipts.description: Whether the app offers its own cash-receipt request. Always false for Toss Payments: the Toss window issues the receipt

TossConfirm.description: Body of POST /v1/checkouts/{id}/toss-confirm: the values Toss appends to successUrl.

amount.description: The amount Toss shows; must equal the checkout's charge

BillingSetup.description: Card registration parameters, or {"enabled": false} when no gateway can save cards. PortOne first (its billing or card channel), else Toss Payments, which saves card only, with its billing MID keys.

store_id.description: PortOne store id; null for Toss Payments

channels.description: Method code to key: PortOne channel keys, or for Toss Payments {"card": <billing MID client key>}

issue_id.description: Registration ticket (UUID v4); the Toss customerKey of the new card

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Page size, 1 to 100 (default 50). Out of range is 400 invalid_limit.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque; the X-Next-Cursor value of the previous page. Malformed is 400 invalid_cursor.

Before.name: before
Before.description: created_at (RFC 3339) of the oldest message already shown.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Retrying with the same key and body replays the first response for 24 hours (header Idempotent-Replayed: true). The same key with a different body is 400 idempotency_key_reused. A request still running is 409 idempotency_in_progress.

NextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page. Absent on the last page.

schema.description: Shape documented per route in the handler's request type; unknown fields are rejected on staff routes.

Error.description: Error envelope. Codes are stable; see docs/api/README.md for the list of common codes.
